actuator.note: hard rate limit: 2 deg travel, 0.02 rad/s slew (below the law's own 3 deg/s command slew limit), 0.25 s lag

reasons.detail: the actuator-free point-mass twin inserts on the same law with 474 kg of margin while native-rigidbody does not (depletion), so the mission was achievable and the tank paid for it: what failed is realising the command through the servo (2.0 deg travel, 1.15 deg/s slew, 0.25 s lag). Neither a law failure nor a vehicle limit.

actuator.note: no TVC axis (the original F-06 stage)

reasons.detail: the original F-06 upper stage has no TVC travel, so the shared law cannot even be instantiated on it (TvcActuator requires positive travel); it flies the F-06 open-loop upper stage on a 4622 m/s ideal delta-v budget. This is the pre-E1-03 baseline, not a guidance result.
